title: Self-checkable execution contract vectors
status: fixture-only; static vectors are normative, runtime conformance is NOT ASSESSED / NOT RUN

canonicalization.json: RFC 8785 JCS: UTF-8, sorted object keys, minimal separators, no trailing LF.
canonicalization.sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact canonical_json or UTF-8 byte string named by the vector.
canonicalization.mutation: Parse the named base, apply JSON-pointer mutation/removal, validate before any effect, and compare the exact expected error and side-effect assertions.
canonicalization.external_objects: EvidenceRef availability and signatures are outside fixture scope; digest arithmetic and schema behavior are in scope.

launch_identity.rule: LCR-1: content then record then envelope; every identity is allocated before it is hashed; a derived identifier is validated by recomputation only

L0.contents: immutable caller payload, preallocated owning identity and nonce

L1.contents: L0 content, L0 digest, record identity, role and version

L2.contents: L1 record, L1 digest, audience and transport metadata
excluded_from_own_hash: the envelope's own digest when defined

bootstrap_identities.hash_exempt_rule: preallocated; may appear in L0 content; never derived from a launch digest
derived once; excluded from L0 input_digest

bootstrap_identities.allocator: supervisor, from launch_id and L0 input_digest
bootstrap_identities.hash_exempt_rule: derived once; excluded from L0 input_digest
allocated by Crier; may appear in the response, never in the request's L0 digest
preallocated; ordering fields are not derived from the record digest

bootstrap_identities.allocator: Crier, after the unsigned response payload
bootstrap_identities.hash_exempt_rule: excludes itself and the signature; covers only the unsigned payload digest

bootstrap_identities.allocator: reporter, after the final report body
bootstrap_identities.hash_exempt_rule: excludes itself and its signature; may include the round-summary digest

derivation_formulas.input_digest: sha256 over the L0 canonical bytes only
derivation_formulas.commitment_digest: sha256 over JCS(commitment) excluding commitment_digest and every higher-layer field
derivation_formulas.report_digest: sha256 over JCS(final report body) excluding report_digest and the signature

launch_identity.recomputation_rule: a reader recomputes every derived value once from the published formula; a mismatch is CONTRACT_INVALID and no fixed-point search is permitted
